values.note: $20 a night for a New Jersey resident, $25 for a non-resident, on every family tent/trailer site (CS01-CS65), as listed on NJ Outdoors, read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.njportal.com/DEP/NJOutdoors/Park/Details?locationId=15 (each site's 'Cost', ResidentCost 20.00 / NonResidentCost 25.00 on all 65 CS sites), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 65 family campsites (CS01-CS65) on NJ Outdoors: 53 take trailers, 38 of them listing a maximum trailer length of 23 ft or more (up to 40 ft; others 15-20 ft), and 12 are tent-only. Also 3 group sites and 6 shelters.

sites.source: https://www.njportal.com/DEP/NJOutdoors/Park/ListSiteAvailabilityJson (locationId=15: SiteTypes and TrailerLength per site) + SiteFilter by trailer length (40 sites pass at 23 ft, 4 at 40 ft, none at 50), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.njportal.com/DEP/NJOutdoors/Park/SiteFilter (locationId=15: no site returned for Electricity Access, Electric 30/50 Amp Hookup or Water Hookup), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.njportal.com/DEP/NJOutdoors/Park/Details?locationId=15 (amenities 'Bathhouse' and 'RV/Trailer Sanitary Station' within facility, 'Laundry' within 10 miles; every family site 'Toilets: Flush' and Shower Access; park map icons Drinking Water, Restroom, Sanitary Dump Station), read 2026-11-11

values.note: On the NJ Outdoors calendar sites CS01-CS21 are open from April 1 and stay open to December 14 (2026); the other sites open April 2 and close after October 30. The 2027 calendar so far closes every site after October 30.

season.source: https://www.njportal.com/DEP/NJOutdoors/Park/ListSiteAvailabilityJson (locationId=15, nightly site status sampled 2026-11-12 to 2027-12-17), read 2026-11-11

note: Sites CS01-CS21 and CS30-CS33 sit on the open grass loop, the rest under trees; on NJ Outdoors several wooded sites (CS46, CS61, CS64, CS65) take 35-ft trailers. Boat launch on Swartswood Lake. --Claude
summary: NJ Outdoors read (dep.nj.gov park page UNREAD: Incapsula block, Wayback 429). Confirmed $20/$25, 65 sites, no hookups, showers/flush/dump. Added max_rig_ft 40 with site-length breakdown (38 trailer sites take 23 ft+), season widened 10-31 -> 12-15 (CS01-CS21 open to Dec 14 in 2026), laundry cleared (NJ Outdoors lists it within 10 miles, not on site). Note: 'wooded sites are tent-only' corrected (NJ Outdoors types wooded CS46/CS61/CS64/CS65 Tent,Trailer at 35 ft; grass vs woods placed from NJ Outdoors' ParkMap_15), NJ Outdoors line dropped.
flags: Phone: none stored; NJ Outdoors gives the park's 'Direct Line: (973) 383-5230' (https://www.njportal.com/DEP/NJOutdoors/Park/Details?locationId=15).

Pin 41.07360,-74.81885: no per-site coordinates exist (no OSM pitches; NJ Outdoors' site map is unreferenced pixels). OSM's camp_site polygon (way 40206096, mislabelled 'Swartswood Day Use Area', 41.0719-41.0806 N) and a campground toilet building at 41.07746,-74.81843 put the loops in the woods north of the day-use area between the lake and CR 619. On imagery the pin is at the south edge of that area beside the open meadow that ParkMap_15 draws as the grass loop (CS01-CS21); the wooded loops run north under canopy. Estimated site centroid about 41.0754,-74.8197, roughly 200 m from the pin, so no move proposed.
Waterfront: NJ Outdoors flags no site as waterfront (WaterfrontSite false on all); the park map puts the far loop (CS43-CS65) near the lake with a trail between. Stored 'not waterfront' kept.
Group sites A and C show 'ClosedNonSeasonal' on every 2027 night on NJ Outdoors (family sites unaffected).
